observedinthePd-catalyzedHeck-typereactionsofalkenes
(Scheme1). The catalytic cycle of the Heck reaction was
based on the Pd
0–PdII–Pd0 pathway,[3] whereas in PdII-
catalyzed reactions the catalyst was regenerated through a
b-heteroatom elimination.

example of PdII-catalyzed “walking” of the carbon–carbon
pbondoveracarbonchaininwhichthecombinationofcyclic
